//go:build linux && udp_integration

package udpreply

import (
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// Establish ordinary IPv6 neighbor discovery from the container's assigned
// address before testing replies with an intentionally nonlocal source address.
// This is network-fixture setup, not a replacement for peer delivery assertions.
func TestMain(m *testing.M) {
	if target := os.Getenv("UDP_REPLY_PEER6"); target != "" {
		host, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(target)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		conn, err := net.DialTimeout("udp6", net.JoinHostPort(host, "9"), time.Second)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "IPv6 fixture route:", err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		_ = conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(time.Second))
		if _, err = conn.Write([]byte{0}); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "IPv6 fixture warmup:", err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		_, err = conn.Read(make([]byte, 1))
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "IPv6 assigned-source neighbor warmup:", conn.LocalAddr(), "result:", err)
		_ = conn.Close()
	}
	os.Exit(m.Run())
}
